# Basic Markdown

Most Quarto documents are written using Markdown.

Markdown is a lightweight syntax for adding structure and formatting to plain text.

## Headings

```markdown
# Heading 1

## Heading 2

### Heading 3
```

## Bold and Italics

```markdown
*italic text*

**bold text**
```


## Lists

Unordered list:

```markdown
- Item one
- Item two
- Item three
```

Ordered list:

```markdown
1. First item
2. Second item
3. Third item
```

## Links 

`You should always create [clear descriptive links](https://teachinghub.bath.ac.uk/guide/creating-meaningful-links/).`

You should always create [clear descriptive links](https://teachinghub.bath.ac.uk/guide/creating-meaningful-links/).


## Basic Images

Basic images with alt text are created with:
```markdown
![Figure caption:here are some dice](images/dice.png){fig-alt="4 colourful 
dice tumbling mid air"}
```

![Figure caption:here are some dice](images/dice.png){fig-alt="4 colourful dice tumbling mid air"}

We will cover how to include figures that you can reference, caption etc in @sec-figures.
